# A route's markup is a sequence of literal chunks and holes the server fills.
# An `if` or a `for` the optimizer could not settle is a hole -- its shape is
# the request's -- and codegen.HoleIf/HoleFor exist for exactly that, with the
# Go emitter writing a real `if` and `for ... range` into the response buffer.
#
# The render model never produced either. It walked the body inline instead:
# both arms of an if were emitted one after the other, and a loop body was
# emitted once with its variable bound to nothing -- so every expression over
# that variable read as unrenderable and the whole route was refused.

# #214 gave a component's body the tree check every other position already had,
# so `main` names `root` here rather than `node`. Spelled that way the window is
# a package window, and the html/go route path then panics on the server-action
# handler ("go has no implementation of intrinsic CreateNode") and stops
# emitting the loop as a HoleFor. Both reproduce on the parent commit with the
# window written at the root of a file, so the mislabel was the only thing
# hiding them, and both are outside #214.
skip 'html route mode mis-lowers a server-action handler when the window is a package window rather than a statement in a node component'

sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out app.sngl

# The loop is ranged in the handler, not flattened into the page.
grep 'for _, row := range' out/server.go

# The conditional is a branch in the handler, not both arms concatenated.
grep 'if ' out/server.go
grep 'named' out/server.go
grep 'unnamed' out/server.go

-- go.mod --
module dynbody

go 1.24

-- srv/srv.go --
package srv

type Row struct {
	Name string
}

func Rows(pkg string) []Row { return []Row{{Name: pkg}} }

func Bump(n int) int { return n + 1 }

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "go:dynbody/srv"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component main root {
    var hits = 0

    window #page(title="t", href="/p/{pkg}") {
        html.button(innerText="go", @click { hits = srv.Bump(hits) })
        if pkg != "" {
            html.span(innerText="named")
        } else {
            html.span(innerText="unnamed")
        }
        for var row = srv.Rows(pkg) {
            html.a(href="/r/" + row.name, innerText=row.name)
        }
    }
}
